paragraphs: Posted by Lily. This week, Teacher Kim asked the Explorers a question. "Is a book better than a film?" Everybody had an opinion, so we wrote our opinions and our reasons for the blog. Teacher Kim gave us ten minutes to think. Here are four of them.

Lily says, "I think that a book is better, because I can make the pictures in my own head." "I can stop at any time, and I can read a page again." "I like to read in bed with a pillow behind my back." "For me, that is the perfect end of a day." "My favorite book is about a small boat." "It makes me feel calm." "I often read for one hour before I sleep."

Leo says, "I think that a film is better, because I can see and hear everything." "The pictures are very clear, and the music makes the story big." "A film is a great invention, because it shows places that I cannot visit." "The feelings are strong, too." "Last week, we saw a film about a robot." "It was very funny." "My friends and I always sit in the front row." "I laugh louder with my friends in a cinema than at home."

Mia says, "I think that both are good, because a good story is always a good story." "I like a film about animals, because I can watch them move." "After the film, I read a book about the same animals." "Then I know the facts, too." "I write the facts in my notebook." "It is a good way to learn." "My favorite animal is the elephant."

May says, "I think that a book is better, because it is cheaper." "A film is only two hours long, but a book can last for a week." "I read every night." "A book is quiet, and I like quiet." "Also, I can borrow a book from the school library for nothing." "My mom works in a library, so I have a lot of books at home."

Teacher Kim read all four opinions and smiled. Then she looked at the Explorers. "An opinion is not right or wrong," she said. "A good opinion has a reason, and the word because helps you to give it." "What is your opinion, and what is your reason?"
text.summary: Teacher Kim asks the Explorers if a book is better than a film. Lily, Leo, Mia, and May each give an opinion and a reason with because, and Teacher Kim says that a good opinion needs a reason.
